tasks.title: ngv2/artifact_harvester.py -- deterministic stage-output parser (pure core + thin I/O wrapper)
acceptance_criteria: NEW file ngv2/artifact_harvester.py exists and is importable as `from ngv2.artifact_harvester import parse_stage_artifact, harvest_stage_artifacts`.

parse_stage_artifact has the EXACT signature parse_stage_artifact(filename: str, content: str, phase: str) -> dict | None and classifies one file purely from filename suffix + content (no disk, network, clock, randomness).

Rule order is preserved: `_poc.py` -> python poc; `_poc.js` -> javascript poc; `_submission.md` -> markdown report; `_report.json` OR filename == 'detonation_report.json' -> JSON report (verdict=parsed.get('verdict'), data=parsed) with fail-closed None on json.JSONDecodeError; otherwise None.
phase is accepted but does NOT change classification.

harvest_stage_artifacts(phase: str, output_dir: str) -> list[dict] is the ONLY filesystem-touching code: it lists files directly in output_dir, reads each file's text, delegates to parse_stage_artifact, and collects non-None results -- with NO classification logic of its own.
Only stdlib json, os, and typing are imported; no third-party packages, no sibling ngv2/** leaf, no network/clock/randomness/subprocess/logging.
No eval/exec/__import__/os.system/subprocess call and no decorators (AST enforcer clean).
Edge cases (a)-(f) from the brief all hold exactly as specified.
verification: `python3 -m pytest -q tests/ngv2/test_artifact_harvester_wired.py` is GREEN; the committed oracle is NOT modified.

spec.objective: Create the NEW single-file module ngv2/artifact_harvester.py exposing a PURE deterministic classifier parse_stage_artifact(filename, content, phase) -> dict|None that turns one stage-output file into a contract-shaped artifact dict (kinds: poc | report), plus a THIN I/O wrapper harvest_stage_artifacts(phase, output_dir) -> list[dict] that sweeps a directory and collects non-None results, so the conductor can ingest stage output with zero hand-copying.
functional_requirements: POC classification: when filename ends with '_poc.py' return {'kind': 'poc', 'language': 'python', 'source': content, 'filename': filename}; when it ends with '_poc.js' return the same shape with 'language': 'javascript'.
Markdown report classification: when filename ends with '_submission.md' return {'kind': 'report', 'format': 'markdown', 'markdown': content, 'filename': filename}.

JSON report classification (fail-closed): when filename ends with '_report.json' OR filename == 'detonation_report.json', parse content via json.loads; on success return {'kind': 'report', 'verdict': parsed.get('verdict'), 'data': parsed, 'filename': filename}; on json.JSONDecodeError return None and never emit a malformed report.

Default + determinism: any other filename returns None; rules are evaluated in the order poc.py -> poc.js -> submission.md -> report.json -> default; the phase argument is accepted as context only and never alters classification; the core performs zero I/O.

Thin wrapper harvest_stage_artifacts(phase, output_dir) lists files directly in output_dir, reads each file's text, calls parse_stage_artifact(filename, content, phase), and collects every non-None result into a list -- containing no classification logic and being the only filesystem-touching code.
spec.interfaces: parse_stage_artifact(filename: str, content: str, phase: str) -> dict | None  ;  harvest_stage_artifacts(phase: str, output_dir: str) -> list[dict]. Importable as `from ngv2.artifact_harvester import parse_stage_artifact, harvest_stage_artifacts`. Output dict shapes feed downstream ngv2/contracts.py PoC (finding_id/language/code/entrypoint) and LiveTestReport (poc_finding_id/verdict/exit_code/stdout/stderr/duration_ms) -- those contracts are a fixed reference and are NOT modified.
edge_cases: (f) parse_stage_artifact('x_report.json', '{not valid json', phase) -> None (FAIL-CLOSED on invalid JSON).
A '_report.json' whose content parses to JSON lacking a 'verdict' key yields verdict == None (parsed.get('verdict')) while still emitting the report dict.
phase varying across all calls (empty string, arbitrary stage name) never changes the returned shape.
non_goals: Do NOT execute, import, or detonate harvested PoC source -- this module only PARSES file text into dicts.

Do NOT wire this harvester into the live conductor, SessionDB, or package step; conductor/SessionDB integration is a separate downstream EDIT leaf and is OUT OF SCOPE. The integration-test requirement is excused because this is a self-contained parser with no live call site.
Do NOT author or modify any test other than the committed oracle tests/ngv2/test_artifact_harvester_wired.py.
Do NOT add network, clock, randomness, subprocess, or logging; the only I/O is the wrapper's directory listing + file reads.
Do NOT import any third-party package or any sibling ngv2/** leaf (only json, os, typing from stdlib); no eval/exec/__import__/os.system/subprocess call and no decorators.
spec.implementation_notes:
Single whole-file emission. Imports: only json, os, typing. parse_stage_artifact is pure: use str.endswith checks in the exact rule order, wrap json.loads in try/except json.JSONDecodeError returning None. harvest_stage_artifacts uses os.listdir(output_dir), os.path.join + os.path.isfile to keep to files directly in the directory, opens each with a text read, calls the pure core, and appends non-None results. Keep the wrapper free of any classification branching. The committed oracle is the authoritative acceptance contract and reachability (*_wired) proof -- make it GREEN without touching it.

# CREDENTIAL-NAMING CONSTRAINT (the AST security gate FAILS the build if a variable whose name contains (case-insensitive) "password", "secret", or "key" is assigned a string literal -- it reads as a hardcoded credential even though this is an external clean-room target with no real secret). NEVER bind a string literal to such a variable. Use a neutral name instead (field_name, check_id, label, name, ident, column) or iterate a collection literal / build the mapping from a list of tuples. This applies to dict keys held in a temp var, field labels, and constant identifiers.

# STDLIB-ONLY CONSTRAINT (the verification environment installs NO third-party packages, so importing one fails collection -> the whole build is rolled back and the leaf is parked). Import ONLY the Python standard library. Import NO third-party package: NO pydantic, NO pydantic_settings, NO attrs, NO pyyaml, NO numpy, NO requests, etc. For data models / config use stdlib dataclasses (dataclasses.dataclass), enum.Enum, typing, and plain dict / json instead of pydantic BaseModel / BaseSettings. If the spec mentions pydantic-style validation, re-express it with stdlib dataclasses + manual checks.

# DETERMINISM CONSTRAINT (the AST nondeterminism gate FAILS the build if it sees a wall-clock or nondeterministic source). Do NOT call datetime.now / datetime.utcnow, time.time / time.monotonic, unseeded random, uuid, os.urandom, or secrets to obtain a timestamp / id / randomness. Instead accept any timestamp, seed, or clock as an EXPLICIT parameter with a deterministic default (the oracle injects it, e.g. via now_fn / make_scripted_clock), so the same inputs always produce the same output.


# COMMITTED ORACLE CONTRACT (authoritative; you cannot read these files at synthesis time so they are reproduced verbatim -- your code MUST make them pass):

## tests/ngv2/test_artifact_harvester_wired.py
```python
"""RED oracle for ngv2.artifact_harvester -- the deterministic stage-output parser
that turns one pipeline-stage output FILE into a contract-shaped artifact dict
(a PoC artifact or a report artifact) ready for SessionDB insertion, so the
conductor ingests stage output with zero hand-copying between output dirs.

The PURE core parse_stage_artifact(filename, content, phase) -> dict | None
classifies a file deterministically by filename suffix + content ONLY (no disk,
no network, no clock, no randomness): "_poc.py"/"_poc.js" -> poc artifact;
"_submission.md" -> markdown report; "_report.json"/"detonation_report.json" ->
JSON report (fail-closed to None on invalid JSON); anything else -> None.

This oracle is the *_wired reachability proof: importing parse_stage_artifact
AND harvest_stage_artifacts from the live ngv2.artifact_harvester module is the
wiring contract.
"""
import json

from ngv2.artifact_harvester import parse_stage_artifact, harvest_stage_artifacts


# --- wiredness / contract: both functions importable, callable, right types ---
def test_wiredness_both_functions_importable_and_callable():
    # the pure core is importable and callable...
    assert callable(parse_stage_artifact)
    # ...and the thin I/O wrapper is exported alongside it (ingest-path contract)
    assert callable(harvest_stage_artifacts)
    # a non-matching file deterministically yields None
    assert parse_stage_artifact("notes.txt", "anything", "package") is None


# --- (a) "x_poc.py" + python source -> kind="poc", language="python" ----------
def test_python_poc_artifact_shape():
    src = "import target_pkg\ntarget_pkg.run()\n"
    res = parse_stage_artifact("x_poc.py", src, "confirm")
    assert res == {
        "kind": "poc",
        "language": "python",
        "source": src,
        "filename": "x_poc.py",
    }


# --- (b) "x_poc.js" -> language="javascript" ----------------------------------
def test_javascript_poc_artifact_shape():
    src = "const x = require('target');\n"
    res = parse_stage_artifact("x_poc.js", src, "confirm")
    assert res["kind"] == "poc"
    assert res["language"] == "javascript"
    assert res["source"] == src
    assert res["filename"] == "x_poc.js"


# --- (c) "huntr_x_submission.md" -> kind="report", format="markdown" ----------
def test_markdown_submission_report_shape():
    md = "# Title\n\nA huntr submission body.\n"
    res = parse_stage_artifact("huntr_x_submission.md", md, "submit")
    assert res["kind"] == "report"
    assert res["format"] == "markdown"
    assert res["markdown"] == md
    assert res["filename"] == "huntr_x_submission.md"


# --- (d) "detonation_report.json" '{"verdict":"confirmed"}' -> verdict carried -
def test_detonation_report_json_verdict_extracted():
    content = '{"verdict": "confirmed"}'
    res = parse_stage_artifact("detonation_report.json", content, "detonate")
    assert res["kind"] == "report"
    assert res["verdict"] == "confirmed"
    assert res["data"] == {"verdict": "confirmed"}
    assert res["filename"] == "detonation_report.json"


def test_generic_report_json_suffix_also_parsed():
    content = '{"verdict": "refuted", "exit_code": 1}'
    res = parse_stage_artifact("foo_report.json", content, "detonate")
    assert res["kind"] == "report"
    assert res["verdict"] == "refuted"
    assert res["data"]["exit_code"] == 1


# --- (e) "notes.txt" -> None --------------------------------------------------
def test_unrecognized_filename_returns_none():
    assert parse_stage_artifact("notes.txt", "anything", "package") is None
    assert parse_stage_artifact("README", "x", "package") is None


# --- (f) "_report.json" with invalid JSON -> None (fail-closed) ---------------
def test_invalid_json_report_fails_closed_to_none():
    assert parse_stage_artifact("x_report.json", "{not valid json", "detonate") is None
    assert parse_stage_artifact("detonation_report.json", "", "detonate") is None


# --- determinism --------------------------------------------------------------
def test_output_is_deterministic():
    a = parse_stage_artifact("x_poc.py", "x = 1\n", "confirm")
    b = parse_stage_artifact("x_poc.py", "x = 1\n", "confirm")
    assert json.dumps(a, sort_keys=True) == json.dumps(b, sort_keys=True)

```

test_spec.test_data_requirements: Pure-core cases need only inline (filename, content, phase) string tuples mirroring brief edge cases (a)-(f). Wrapper test needs a temporary directory populated with a small mix of files (e.g. x_poc.py, x_poc.js, huntr_x_submission.md, detonation_report.json with valid JSON, x_report.json with invalid JSON, notes.txt) to assert only valid artifacts are collected. No network, clock, or randomness.
